overview: شلک هولمز زمانی که زنان جوان در اطراف لندن کشته می‌شوند و هر کدام انگشت‌شان قطع شده، تحقیق می‌کند. اسکاتلند یارد معتقد است که یک دیوانه درگیر است، اما هولمز معتقد است که این قتل‌ها بخشی از یک طرح شیطانی هستند.
overview_en: IMDB - http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0038259/combined Basil Rathbone & Nigel Bruce played Sherlock Holmes & Dr. Watson in fourteen films between 1939-1946. Of these fourteen films, four fell into the public domain according to WikiPedia: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rathbone-Bruce_Sherlock_Holmes_Films These four films are: SHERLOCK HOLMES AND THE SECRET WEAPON (1943) http://www.archive.org/details/secret_weapon SHERLOCK HOLMES - THE WOMAN IN GREEN (1945) (this page) http://www.archive.org/details/TheWomanInGreen_894 (other formats) SHERLOCK HOLMES - TERROR BY NIGHT (1946) http://www.archive.org/details/Terror_By_Night SHERLOCK HOLMES - DRESSED TO KILL (1946) http://www.archive.org/details/dressed_to_kill Of the 4 public domain films (or all 14 for that matter), THE WOMAN IN GREEN is a key film in that the arch-enemy of Holmes, Professor Moriarty, finally gets his just due.
